units.source_text: 斜面忽然变得陡峭起来。
他大致目测了一下，这一带，距离屋顶，至少也有二十米左右。

en.t: He made a rough estimate by eye and figured that this area was at least about twenty meters from the rooftops.

units.source_text: 人们到底是怎样过日子的呢，

en.t: How on earth did people live here,

units.source_text: 他觉得很纳闷，想看看深邃洞穴底部的一间屋子，

en.t: he wondered, curious to see one of the houses at the bottom of the deep hollow,

units.source_text: 谁知他刚沿着边缘走了一圈，就被忽然刮来的一阵大风，吹得连气都喘不过来。

en.t: but no sooner had he walked once around the edge than a sudden gust of wind came whipping in and left him unable even to breathe.

units.source_text: 他猛地睁开眼，眼前已经是大海了，

en.t: He snapped his eyes open, and there before him was the sea,

units.source_text: 泡沫四溅，浑浊的海浪翻滚着，拍打着眼前的海滩。

en.t: foam spraying everywhere as muddy waves rolled and crashed against the beach in front of him.

units.source_text: 原来自己已经站在目的地沙丘的顶端了。

en.t: He realized that he was already standing at the top of the dune he had been heading for.
